As Enlink Midstream (ENLC) Market Valuation Declined, Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors LP Upped by $499,800 Its Position; Apple Computer (AAPL) Stake Has Boosted by Northeast Financial Consultants Inc
April 30, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors Lp increased its stake in Enlink Midstream Llc (ENLC) by 12.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors Lp bought 29,400 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.15% with the market. The hedge fund held 260,100 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.58M, up from 230,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kayne Anderson Capital Advisors Lp who had been investing in Enlink Midstream Llc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.20% or $0.0296 during the last trading session, reaching $14.8204. About 204,344 shares traded. EnLink Midstream, LLC (NYSE:ENLC) has declined 21.83% since April 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.38% the S&P500.
Northeast Financial Consultants Inc increased its stake in Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) by 25.03% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northeast Financial Consultants Inc bought 3,637 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 18,168 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.08M, up from 14,531 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northeast Financial Consultants Inc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $837.42B market cap company. The stock increased 1.68% or $2.72 during the last trading session, reaching $165.04. About 31.81M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
